camel_example: aliyun dms-enterprise ListUserPermissions --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 5 --PageNumber 1 --UserId 510000 --DatabaseName db_name --SearchKey 'rm-bp144d5ky4l4r0000' --PermType DATABASE --Logic false --Tid 3000 --EnvType dev --DbType polardb
description_en: Queries the permissions of a user on databases and tables
description_zh: 调用ListUserPermissions展示指定用户所具备的库表权限
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise list-user-permissions --tid 3000 --perm-type DATABASE --user-id 510000 --database-name db_name --search-key rm-bp144d5ky4l4r0000 --logic false --env-type dev --db-type polardb --page-number 1 --page-size 5 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUserPermissions

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see the "View information about the current tenant" section of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
鼠标移动到界面右上角的头像处，查看租户ID。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en:
The permissions on a specific type of resources that you want to query. Valid values:

DATABASE: permissions on databases
TABLE: permissions on tables
COLUMN: permissions on fields
INSTANCE: permissions on instances
parameters.help_zh:
资源权限类型，取值如下：

DATABASE： 库权限
TABLE：表权限
COLUMN：列权限
INSTANCE: 实例权限
parameters.name: perm_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html operation to query the ID of the user.

The user ID is different from the ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html获取该参数的值。
用户ID不是用户的阿里云Uid
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword used in the query. For example, if you want to query permissions on an instance, you can specify the endpoint of the instance, such as rm-bp144d5ky4l4r****
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词。例如，搜索实例权限，此处可填入DMS中的实例地址，如：rm-bp144d5ky4l4r****
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

true: The database is a logical database.
false: The database is a physical database
parameters.help_zh:
是否逻辑库，取值：
true：逻辑库
false：物理库
parameters.name: logic

parameters.help_en:
The type of the environment to which the database belongs. Valid values:

product: production environment
dev: development environment
pre: staging environment
test: test environment
sit: SIT environment
uat: user acceptance testing (UAT) environment
pet: stress testing environment
stag: STAG environment
parameters.help_zh:
环境类型，取值如下：
product：生产环境
dev：开发环境
pre：预发环境
test：测试环境
sit：SIT环境
uat：UAT环境
pet：压测环境
stag：STAG环境
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The type of the database. For more information about the valid values of this parameter, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198106.html
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size
